Subject: Azure marketplace onboarding — delegated identity & manifest checks

Hi Ben,

Great to meet you on the kickoff. I wanted to follow up with the immediate items we'll need to unblock the publisher account and the offer manifest validation for Contoso's listing: 

1) Delegated identity (SPN): Please provide the Service Principal (appId + tenant) that you'll use for the delegated identity flow. The SPN needs either Contributor rights on the subscription used for testing or a custom role that allows Microsoft to provision offers (we prefer Contributor on the offer sandbox subscription).

2) Publisher tenant proof: a short PDF confirming tenant ownership (signed admin screenshot or portal export).

3) Manifest: we require a manifest JSON that follows the marketplace schema — specifically the `resourceType` and `plan` sections must match our enum values. I've attached a small sample manifest (sample-manifest.json) and a quick SPN delegation guide (spn-delegation-guide.txt).

4) Co-sell registration: please complete the DocuSign link below (partner admin) and confirm the HubSpot record.

DocuSign: https://docusign.net/sign/abc123
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/contoso
Docs: https://docs.microsoft.com/marketplace/publisher-delegated-identity

Can you confirm the SPN appId and whether you prefer us to validate the manifest JSON server-side or you want the validation output first? Also propose a 30-minute review slot this week so we can walk through the manifest mismatches (if any).

Thanks,

— Asha Raman
Azure Marketplace Onboarding
Microsoft Corp.

Quick answers: 
- We can run server-side manifest validation and return a failure report — please attach your working manifest and we will validate and return a findings file.
- Managed Identity: for publisher onboarding we require a principal with an appId that we can reference; Managed Identity isn't supported for the initial offer provisioning step because we need an appId in the manifest. Use the SPN approach.
- DocuSign: the link is active, it requires a partner admin to sign. Please confirm when that's completed.
